description: Registry of newly supplied Cloudinary photographs for the Wissa Sobhy Tadros archive. These records preserve provenance while detailed visual description, dating, occasion and contextual attribution remain pending direct asset inspection. In Nov 2026, fourteen family-archive scans (ordination 1991, first liturgy, hegumenate 1997, diaconate undated) were visually reviewed and added under /photos/ with conservative captions; crowd-heavy scans were reviewed but held back from the public gallery.
